Monthly upstream review ([upstream policy](https://github.com/danfry1/vitest-native/blob/main/packages/vitest-native/docs/upstream-policy.md#6-ownership-and-review)). Record each item here; close the issue when done.

## Releases
- [ ] Upstream releases since the last review (Node, Vite, Vitest, React, React Native, Expo, RNTL), and which we adopted (Dependabot PRs merged, pins moved).
- [ ] New upstream majors due, and their canary status (`Canary (…)` in compat-check).

## Floors
- [ ] Recommended floors moved this month, each with its upstream issue and fixed release.
- [ ] Hard floors moved (minor releases only), with the reason: correctness for many users, or security.

## Workarounds
- [ ] Entries in `docs/upstream-workarounds.md` whose expiry test now fails: deleted, with their tests and rows.
- [ ] New entries, each with its upstream issue linked.

## Axes and canaries
- [ ] The latest-supported column (RN matrix) and the Expo latest-patch job: green, or a tracking issue open.
- [ ] Open `compat-check` issues: each with an owner.
